name: Sit-to-Stand

instructions.description: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair with feet flat and about hip width apart.
Lean your trunk slightly forward from the hips and brace your core.
Press through your feet to stand up fully without using momentum.
Reach the hips back and lower to the chair with control.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use hand support only as needed.

variations.variationDescription: Very closely related loaded pattern using the chair as the start and end position.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use the chair arms lightly to assist the ascent.

commentsNotes: Keep the knees aligned with the feet.
